Zip Rippers was a line of three-wheeled 1:64 scaled Hot Wheels vehicles who's main gimmick was each vehicle having a ripcord that could be used with the vehicle to push them off at powerful speeds. The line which was under the HW RACE banner lasted from 2015 to 2016 and was quietly discontinued after it's two year run, most likely due to poor sales and distribution.
